summary: Verified the Datto-as-evidence fix in GET /api/devices (fix for false-red on Windows/Hyper-V servers). Wrote 7 pytest cases covering positive promotions (via datto_uid, IP, MAC) and negative/regression cases (datto offline, stale heartbeat, no evidence, ping reachable). All 7 passed. Tests use isolated TEMP clients and fully clean up managed_devices, device_poll_status, datto_devices, discovered_endpoints and clients.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/devices.py is 2192 lines — consider splitting the get_devices handler and its helpers into a dedicated module (device_status_resolver.py) for readability. Not blocking.

The Datto freshness threshold (30 minutes) is hardcoded at ~line 161. Consider promoting to a module-level constant DATTO_FRESH_MINUTES = 30 to match SCANNER_STALE_SECONDS convention already used below.

_datto_online() ignores per-doc client_id filtering in the datto_online_by_uid lookup (UID is global). If two clients ever share a datto UID (they shouldn't but sanity), the check would leak across tenants. Currently client_id is baked into ip/mac keys but not uid — worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEMP client (UUID id) with a managed_device (10.99.16.10x), a device_poll_status reachable=false, and (where relevant) a datto_devices doc. All docs deleted in test teardown; mongo verified clean after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Datto-as-evidence promotion in GET /api/devices is working end-to-end. Positive: uid/ip/mac all trigger. Negative: online=false and stale (>30min) do NOT promote. Regressions unaffected. Test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_datto_evidence.py and self-cleans.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Windows/Hyper-V servers block ICMP and may not appear in ARP/FDB/SNMP → falsely offline. Fix (routes/devices.py ~L139-189, L441-443, L633-635) queries datto_devices for online=true with datto_last_seen<30min and promotes managed devices via UID/IP/MAC match. Verified: without a matching fresh online datto doc, offline devices stay offline (no false-green).
